en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street parade in a tree‑lined urban area. In the foreground, a marching band in uniform plays instruments such as drums and brass, while many spectators line the sides of the street. Early 20th‑century automobiles and period clothing suggest an historical scene. In the distance, an ornamental arch or gate spans the street. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin of the image.
